summary.zh: 组织多维度并行审查并合并结论
summary.en: Run parallel reviews across quality dimensions

description.zh: 按安全、性能、架构、测试、可访问性等维度分配审查员，给出发现去重、严重级别校准和汇总报告的写法。适合需要对一次改动做多角度评审，或希望统一多个审查意见口径时使用。
description.en: Assigns reviewers across security, performance, architecture, testing, and accessibility, then deduplicates findings, calibrates severity, and produces one consolidated report. Use it for multi-angle reviews of a single change.
